He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is…
“Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ,’ or, ‘There,’ don’t believe it.
Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

translations.web: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,
translations.bsb: People will tell you, ‘Look, there He is!’ or ‘Look, here He is!’ Do not go out or chase after them.
translations.kjv: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow
translations.asv: And they shall say to you, Lo, there! Lo, here! go not away, nor follow after them:
